summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Patrick Kwok Fai Lau effective July 8, 2026, and the appointment of Pang Peter Chun Ming as his replacement. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. Mr. Pang brings over 25 years of experience as a CPA and CFA, having served as CFO and company secretary of several firms. No transaction or material interest ties him to the company. This non-U.S. issuer's report maps to a current report on Form 8-K for departures and appointments of principal officers. What to watch: integration of new CFO into financial reporting and any future strategic shifts.
